## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Blessing Catering?
No. 1, 9th Street, Padi Pudu Nagar Main Road, Anna Nagar Extn., Chennai 600 101.

### What facilities does Blessing Catering have?
A-Z marriage orders, Event management, Birthday parties, House warming, Get-togethers, Corporate orders, Morning tiffin, Lunch, Evening snacks, Night dinner, Reception menu, Briyani (veg & non-veg), Tandoori, Chinese, Chaat & live stalls.

### Do you serve non-veg?
Yes. Blessing Catering serves both veg and non-veg — biryani, tandoori, Chinese, North Indian and South Indian.

### Do you take full wedding orders?
Yes. We undertake A-Z marriage orders and event management, as well as corporate orders.
